entities.name: Battle for Kaldheim
entities.description: A pivotal conflict of the Mending Era on Kaldheim, triggered by a Doomskar that sent undead, demons and giants through torn realm rifts.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A magical catastrophe that tears rifts between realms and releases invaders; ended by Halvar's ritual.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who presents the Sword of the Realms and kills Varragoth.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker from Theros who arrives with the Valkyries and cannot return home.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Prince of the elves of Skemfar and a planeswalker who joins Kaya.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: God of Battle for whom the Sword of the Realms was made; he performs the ritual that ends the Doomskar.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: A powerful Tyrite weapon completed by Koll, made for Halvar.

entities.name: Koll
entities.description: The late smith who completed the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God who reveals the sword was made for Halvar.

entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: Tuskeri representative who holds back the draugr horde.

entities.name: Fynn
entities.description: Kannah representative who clashes with Tyvar.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: Human clan representative at Beskir Stronghold.

entities.name: Sigrid
entities.description: Urges unity among the clans.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description: King of Skemfar and Tyvar's brother who leads the elven army and summons glowing snakes.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: God of the Voyage who washes away undead with a wave.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: Demon lord who attacks the heroes and is killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A primordial serpent that glides into Karfell's rift and disrupts the undead flow.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: Goddess of the World Tree who is mortally wounded by Vorinclex.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A monstrous Phyrexian invader who wounds Esika and opens a planar portal.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Revealed as the source of the conflict, aligned with New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of the battle.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm of the human clans.

entities.name: Beskir Stronghold
entities.description: Where the human clans gather.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: Undead realm from which the army emerges.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm of the Valkyries.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: Realm of the elves.

entities.name: Tyrite Sanctum
entities.description: Place where Esika is wounded.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Sacred tree whose sap Vorinclex draws.

entities.name: Draugr
entities.description: Undead army from Karfell.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Army from Starnheim that attacks the demons.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian force Tibalt aligned with.

events.summary: Representatives of Bretagard's clans gather at Beskir Stronghold with Tyvar and Kaya; Sigrid urges unity against the invaders.
events.quote: Sigrid urged unity, revealing that the realms faced a shared threat

events.summary: Kaya presents the Sword of the Realms; Alrund reveals it was made for Halvar, and the group sets out to find him.
events.quote: it had been made for Halvar , God of Battle, who alone could master it.

events.summary: A rift opens and a draugr army emerges from Karfell; Halvar alone holds a bridge.
events.quote: Halvar alone held a narrow bridge against the draugr

events.summary: Varragoth attacks the heroes on giant ravens; Kaya phases them into incorporeal form to survive the fall.
events.quote: Kaya managed to phase them into incorporeal form just before they hit the river below

events.summary: Tyvar goes to intercept his brother Harald; Cosima washes away an undead troll threatening Kaya.
events.quote: until Cosima , God of the Voyage, arrived and washed away the undead with a summoned wave.

events.summary: Varragoth intercepts Kaya and Cosima; Tyvar and the elven army united under Harald rescue them and let Kaya and Harald reach Halvar.
events.quote: the timely arrival of Tyvar and the elven army, now united under Harald

events.summary: Kaya gives Halvar the Sword; as he begins the ritual, Koma emerges through a tear in the sky and glides into Karfell's rift, disrupting the undead flow.
events.quote: Kaya gave Halvar the Sword of the Realms, which he accepted solemnly.

events.summary: Valkyries and Niko Aris pour out of the rift; Kaya phases through Varragoth's arm and cuts his throat with an axe, killing him.
events.quote: She phased through the demon's arm and swung an axe clean through his throat.

events.summary: Halvar completes the ritual and the Doomskar is sealed, banishing the undead and closing the rifts; the gods vanish; Tyvar accepts Kaya's invitation; Niko learns she cannot return to Theros.
events.quote: the Doomskar was sealed, banishing the undead and closing the rifts between realms.

events.summary: Vorinclex mortally wounds Esika in the Tyrite Sanctum, draws sap from the World Tree and opens a planar portal.
events.quote: Esika , goddess of the World Tree , was mortally wounded by Vorinclex

relations.note: Cut his throat with an axe.
relations.quote: swung an axe clean through his throat.
his brother Harald , King of Skemfar
who had aligned himself with the forces of New Phyrexia

relations.note: Fight together and Tyvar accepts her invitation.
relations.quote: Tyvar accepted Kaya's invitation to travel the Multiverse
